text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Hopeful Stakes. Mejiro Dober, who won her own G1 earlier, comes to the track to show her support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, concerned by how relaxed both Mejiro Bright and I seem, she asks if we're truly ready for the G1 race ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I believe Mejiro Bright is fine as is. I've put my trust in her, letting her know all she has to do is keep her cool.
